subject: Road to PoC — approval gates, timelines, and mutual action plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@lighthousehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Road to PoC — approval gates, timelines, and mutual action plan

Hi Alice — thanks again for the time this morning. Short recap and clear next steps so we can get your Procurement and Legal teams what they need and land a PoC kickoff in December.

Call highlights
- Use case: embed Redwood API for clinical-notes summarization pipeline (SLA: 150ms p95, throughput target: 60 rps)
- Key decision criteria: latency, data residency controls, and audit logs
- Stakeholders you mentioned: you (product lead), Ben Walton (procurement), Dina Patel (legal), and Dr. Nguyen (clinical champion)

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Confirm economic buyer and procurement lead (who will approve contract and budget?) — Alice to confirm by EOD tomorrow.
2) Legal checklist: Dina will need SOC 2 scope, data retention policy, and a sample DPA; I've attached a short SOC2 summary and our standard DPA.
3) Mutual Action Plan (MAP): I attached a first draft (LHW-Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx) — please review milestones and owners.
4) Proposed dates: contract signature target by 2026-12-10; PoC kickoff week of 2026-12-13.

I've looped Rafael (pricing & financing) and Marissa (solutions/implementation) to capture technical milestones and any pricing options. If that timeline looks tight, share where your internal approval gates are so we can adjust.

Attachments: LHW-Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOC2-summary.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a cleaned MAP after we confirm the economic owner.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127

From: Alice Chen <alice@lighthousehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Walton <ben.walton@lighthousehealth.com>, Dina Patel <dina.patel@lighthousehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Road to PoC — approval gates, timelines, and mutual action plan

Thanks Soojin — good recap. A few notes:

- Economic buyer / budget holder: Ben Walton (cc'd). He owns procurement and will sign the PO.
- Procurement timeline: Ben expects to consolidate vendor approvals by 12/03; contract can be routed to finance the week of 12/06 for release by 12/10 if legal sign-off is quick.
- Legal: Dina is copied; she'll own the DPA and standard redlines. She requested SOC 2 type II report or summary and specifics on how logs are retained and exported.
- Clinical champion: Dr. L. Nguyen will join the kickoff call but won't be part of contract approvals.

Ben, Dina — can each confirm your timelines? If we can get SOC2 summary + DPA by EOD Friday (19th), Dina says she'll aim to get redlines back within 5 business days.

Also, a commercial note: our procurement group may request a 60-day net payment term; happy to discuss.

— Alice
Alice Chen
Sr Product Manager | Lighthouse Health
alice@lighthousehealth.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0000
Subject: Fwd: Road to PoC — pricing flexibility and MAP updates

Looping you both on Alice's note. Two quick items from our side:

1) Pricing flexibility: I can approve a PoC discount up to 25% for a 6-week PoC if the customer commits to a production evaluation within 90 days and shares a brief success criteria doc. Anything beyond that needs VP approval.
2) MAP updates: I propose we add a milestone for "Legal redlines returned" (owner: Dina), and "PO issuance" (owner: Ben) with explicit target dates. I've attached a pricing summary that reflects a standard PoC package and the discounted scenario.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx

Marissa — can you confirm the implementation milestones (env setup, test dataset handoff, integration window) and estimate effort? I'll draft the MAP with owners/times once I have that.

— Rafa
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

From: Ben Walton <ben.walton@lighthousehealth.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@lighthousehealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Dina Patel <dina.patel@lighthousehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Road to PoC — approval gates, timelines, and mutual action plan

Confirming procurement side:
- We can aim to issue a PO by 2026-12-09 if legal finishes redlines by 12/03.
- Payment terms: we'll start with the standard net-30; finance may request net-60, but Ben will flag early if they insist.
- Required vendor docs: SOC 2 Type II (or summary), insurer certificate, and data handling overview for PHI (if applicable).

Dina — any immediate redline expectations we should flag to Redwood?

Thanks,
Ben Walton
Director, Procurement | Lighthouse Health
ben.walton@lighthousehealth.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@lighthousehealth.com>, Ben Walton <ben.walton@lighthousehealth.com>, Dina Patel <dina.patel@lighthousehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -0000
Subject: Final MAP draft + request for sign-off & DocuSign

Appreciate everyone's quick responses — attached is an updated MAP with concrete milestones, owners, and dates based on your input:
- 11/27: Legal receives SOC2 summary + DPA (owner: Soojin / Redwood)
- 12/03: Legal redlines returned (owner: Dina / Lighthouse Health)
- 12/06: Procurement issues PO to Finance (owner: Ben)
- 12/10: Target contract signature (owner: Ben / Finance)
- 12/13–12/17: PoC kickoff and environment setup (owner: Marissa)

I've set conservative SLAs for redlines and included the 25% PoC discount option Rafael noted — the pricing summary is attached. Please review the attached LHW-Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx and the pricing summary. If the milestones look right, I'll send the final contract via DocuSign (link below) for Ben's approval and signature.

DocuSign proposal: https://www.docusign.net/TP/SigningStart.aspx?tab=abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/84612
Drive MAP: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cMAPdoc

Attachments: LHW-Redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx, redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx, SOC2-summary.pdf

Please reply-all with an explicit APPROVE or REQUEST CHANGES by 11/27 EOD so we can keep the timeline intact.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.

— Soojin
